cases.spec_ref: `lat diff <base> <rev> --json` — the KEY-aware / type-aware delta. The base changes LOCA_NATE on BH1 (100.00 -> 150.00), removes BH2 and adds BH3, so the serialized delta must report one changed / one removed / one added row with the 2DP cell pair. Documented byte-identical across the three launchers; the JSON body carries no file paths, so identity holds regardless of how each launcher was invoked. `--ndjson` is a SILENT NO-OP on diff (a global flag diff never reads), so `--json` is diff's only machine contract and the one this pins (laterite-dev#555 part 2).
